bible_quanes.question: What is Christ, according to Colossians 1:15?
bible_quanes.answer: The image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature

bible_quanes.question: What was created by Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: All things, in heaven and on earth

bible_quanes.question: What is Christ the head of?
bible_quanes.answer: The body, the church

bible_quanes.question: What is the mystery among the Gentiles?
bible_quanes.answer: Christ in you, the hope of glory

bible_quanes.question: From whom did the Colossians learn the gospel?
bible_quanes.answer: Epaphras

bible_quanes.question: From what has God delivered us?
bible_quanes.answer: The power of darkness
bible_quanes.explanation: Into the kingdom of His Son.

bible_quanes.question: What does Christ do for all things?
bible_quanes.answer: By Him all things consist

bible_quanes.question: How did Christ make peace?
bible_quanes.answer: Through the blood of His cross

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul fill up in his flesh?
bible_quanes.answer: That which is behind of the afflictions of Christ, for His body's sake

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul pray the Colossians would be filled with?
bible_quanes.answer: The knowledge of His will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding

bible_quanes.question: What dwells in Christ bodily?
bible_quanes.answer: All the fulness of the Godhead

bible_quanes.question: How should we walk in Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: As you have received Him

bible_quanes.question: What did Christ wipe out?
bible_quanes.answer: The handwriting of ordinances that was against us

bible_quanes.question: What did Christ do to principalities and powers?
bible_quanes.answer: Spoiled them, made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them

bible_quanes.question: Through what should no man spoil you?
bible_quanes.answer: Philosophy and vain deceit

bible_quanes.question: With what circumcision were believers circumcised?
bible_quanes.answer: The circumcision made without hands

bible_quanes.question: What should no one judge you in?
bible_quanes.answer: Meat, drink, an holyday, the new moon or the sabbath days
bible_quanes.explanation: A shadow of things to come.

bible_quanes.question: With what were believers buried with Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: Baptism

bible_quanes.question: What false worship does Paul warn against?
bible_quanes.answer: Worshipping of angels

bible_quanes.question: Of what value are self-imposed religious rules?
bible_quanes.answer: Not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh

bible_quanes.question: What should we seek if raised with Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: Those things which are above

bible_quanes.question: How should we do whatever we do?
bible_quanes.answer: In the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks

bible_quanes.question: How should we do whatever we do, according to Colossians 3:23?
bible_quanes.answer: Heartily, as to the Lord and not to men

bible_quanes.question: What should we put on above all?
bible_quanes.answer: Charity, which is the bond of perfectness

bible_quanes.question: On what should we set our minds?
bible_quanes.answer: Things above, not on things on the earth

bible_quanes.question: What should we put to death?
bible_quanes.answer: Your members upon the earth: fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, covetousness

bible_quanes.question: What should we put on as God's elect?
bible_quanes.answer: Bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering

bible_quanes.question: What should dwell in us richly?
bible_quanes.answer: The word of Christ

bible_quanes.question: Which groups does Paul say there is neither in Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free

bible_quanes.question: What should fathers not do, according to Colossians 3:21?
bible_quanes.answer: Provoke your children to anger, lest they be discouraged

bible_quanes.question: What should we continue earnestly in?
bible_quanes.answer: Prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving

bible_quanes.question: How should our speech be?
bible_quanes.answer: Alway with grace, seasoned with salt

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul call Luke?
bible_quanes.answer: The beloved physician

bible_quanes.question: How should we walk toward outsiders?
bible_quanes.answer: In wisdom, redeeming the time

bible_quanes.question: Who came with Tychicus to Colosse?
bible_quanes.answer: Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother

bible_quanes.question: Who was Mark's cousin?
bible_quanes.answer: Barnabas

bible_quanes.question: Who laboured fervently in prayers for the Colossians?
bible_quanes.answer: Epaphras

bible_quanes.question: Which other church's letter should the Colossians read?
bible_quanes.answer: The epistle from Laodicea

bible_quanes.question: To whom was the message "Take heed to the ministry" sent?
bible_quanes.answer: Archippus

bible_quanes.question: In whose house was a church in Laodicea?
bible_quanes.answer: Nymphas
